      <title>Mystery over source of Ebola infection in Nigeria fuels concern about spread of virus</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/23/ebola-swiss-patient-nigeria-dr-congo-concerns-virus-spread</link>
      <description><p>Switzerland says patient is wife of Swiss diplomat and believed to have contracted virus while travelling in Uganda</p><p>Health officials across Africa are racing to determine how Nigeria’s first Ebola patient ⁠in more than a decade ⁠became infected, amid fears ​the outbreak could spread further after reaching a fourth African country.</p><p>The Swiss foreign ministry said on Friday the patient in Nigeria, the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, had not travelled to the Democratic Republic of ⁠Congo, where the outbreak was first detected in mid-May before spreading to Uganda, Kenya and now Nigeria. The woman was believed to have contracted Ebola while travelling with her husband in Uganda, the ministry added.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/23/ebola-swiss-patient-nigeria-dr-congo-concerns-virus-spread">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Lewis Hamilton aims to extend career till early 2030s so he can race in African Grand Prix</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/oct/22/lewis-hamilton-aims-to-extend-career-till-early-2030s-so-he-can-race-in-african-grand-prix</link>
      <description><ul><li><p>41-year-old set on ‘dream to be able to race in Africa’</p></li><li><p>Rwanda to host despite criticism of human rights record</p></li></ul><p>Lewis Hamilton has said he hopes to remain racing in Formula One until he can take part in the African Grand Prix which is <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/oct/13/f1-returns-to-africa-for-first-time-since-1993-with-10-year-rwanda-deal-from-early-2030s">set to take place in Rwanda in the 2030s</a>. The seven-time world champion believes it is right that F1 is to hold a race there despite criticism of the country’s human rights record.</p><p>Last week F1 confirmed Rwanda was to host the African Grand Prix having concluded a 10-year agreement for the meeting on a purpose-built circuit, with the first race set for the early 2030s. It is lined up to be held on a circuit in Bugesera, 25 miles south of the capital, Kigali, which has yet to be constructed and marks a return to the African continent for the first time since it last held a race at Kyalami, South Africa in 1993.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/oct/22/lewis-hamilton-aims-to-extend-career-till-early-2030s-so-he-can-race-in-african-grand-prix">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>New Trump rule allows hunters to bait bears in Alaska with doughnuts, bacon and more</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/24/trump-administration-alaska-bear-hunting-bait</link>
      <description><p>Critics decry Trump administration rule that lets hunters lure bears with human foods on federal lands in Alaska</p><p>A new Trump administration rule allows hunters to bait bears on federal lands in Alaska with bacon, doughnuts, meat scraps or other human foods typically used to help kill the trophy animals at close range.</p><p>Opponents say the practice will cause bears to be more aggressive around humans, and allege that the rule change is a political gift to largely rightwing trophy hunters. The rule replaces a 2024 Biden administration rule that banned the practice, and environmental groups criticized the move as “indefensible and inexcusable”.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/24/trump-administration-alaska-bear-hunting-bait">Continue reading...</a></description>
